=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- tests/test_security_pass_skip.py: lines 61-65, specifically line 63 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `SKIP_LABEL_MARKERS` still contains `"ai:check-triage": re.compile(r"(?m)^<!-- check-failure-triage:fp=\S+ -->[ \t]*$")`. The PR's stated intent — and the security finding in issue #6365 — is to remove this entry so a check-failure triage issue (whose body and label derive from contributor-controlled PR failure logs) cannot exempt a linked fix PR from the head-bound security pass. The vulnerability is unchanged on disk: `decide_security_pass_skip` still iterates `SKIP_LABEL_MARKERS` and grants the skip for any `ai:check-triage`-labelled issue that passes the owner-author + at-creation-label + body-marker checks.
  WHY: A malicious or careless contributor who opens a PR with crafted CI failure logs can wait for the check-failure triage workflow to file a `ai:check-triage`-labelled issue under the owner's `GH_PAT`, then open a fix PR linked solely to that issue. The single-issue security pass gate (`SINGLE_ISSUE_SECURITY_PASS_ENABLED`, default `true`) calls this script, finds the `ai:check-triage` entry in `SKIP_LABEL_MARKERS`, verifies the owner-authored label and the `<!-- check-failure-triage:fp=... -->` body marker, and returns `{"skip": True, "label": "ai:check-triage", ...}` — bypassing the audit on a fix PR whose head SHA contains contributor-supplied code.
- tests/test_security_pass_skip.py: line 313 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `test_skip_labels_are_the_automation_labels` asserts `tuple(skip.SKIP_LABEL_MARKERS) == ("ai:security", "ai:check-triage", "ai:workflow-heal")`. This contract test enshrines the vulnerable state: it would fail any future change that correctly removes `ai:check-triage`.
  WHY: The test passes today only because `ai:check-triage` is still in `SKIP_LABEL_MARKERS`. Any reviewer or editor attempting to apply the documented fix (the very change this PR is supposed to introduce) will be blocked by this test, and the test's intent is the opposite of the security finding
